web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's economic growth in the second quarter of 2026 slowed to 4.3%, marking the slowest pace in over three years and falling short of the 4.5% target. This deceleration was driven by weak domestic consumption, which overshadowed robust manufacturing and export sectors. Retail sales rose by 1% in June, while industrial output expanded by 5.3%. Despite these figures, concerns persist about the sustainability of China's growth model, especially amid global economic tensions and imbalances.
